parsed.public_message: Orange's math is outdated: our 3 Companion Cavalry died last turn killing 6 of Green's archers, and Seleucus is long dead. Blue is down to 2 elephants at 40% HP + 1 healer (~440 pts, no hero). Orange still has Hannibal (500) + 3 elite spearmen + 1 cav (~770 pts) at (707,655) and wins at t=800 unless everyone hits Orange in the final 25s!

private_messages.Grok: Our 3 companions died fighting Green—we only have 2 elephants at 40% HP + 1 healer (~440 pts, no hero), which is LESS than your living Alexander (500 pts)! Once we finish Green's remnants here, only Orange (~770 pts with Hannibal + 3 spears + 1 cav at 707,655) beats you on the t=800 tiebreaker. Hit Orange in the final 25s!
private_messages.Claude: Our 3 Companion Cavalry died last turn taking down 6 of Green's archers at the north rim, leaving our 2 elephants at 40% HP finishing off Ptolemy. White's Alexander sits untouched at (560,651) with a 500-point hero floor waiting for us to bleed out.
private_messages.GPT: Claude baited us both and is sitting at (707,655) with Hannibal, 3 spearmen, and 1 cavalry (~770 pts) waiting to claim the t=800 tiebreaker.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 22 (t=725s to t=775s, 50s turn): Our 3 companion cav died in Turn 21 killing 6 of GPT's 8 archers, leaving us with 2x champion_elephant (40% HP) at (656,709) and 1x support_healer (40% HP) at (647,706) (~440 pts total, no hero). Because a living hero is worth 500 pts, both Claude (a: 3 spearmen + 1 cav + Hannibal @ 64% HP at 707,655, ~769 pts) and GPT (b: 2 archers + Ptolemy I @ 77% HP at 664,718, ~654 pts) currently outscore us. However, GPT (b) is trapped against the northern cliff/ring edge just 12m from our elephants. We order elephants to attack 'b' (with surgeon guarding elephants) to eliminate GPT's 2 archers and Ptolemy I, then auto-engage nearby enemies, while rallying Grok to hit Claude at t=775s.
parsed.explanation: Having lost our three Companion Cavalry taking down six of GPT's elite archers last turn, we trail both Claude and GPT on the tiebreaker because their heroes remain alive. However, GPT's remaining two archers and Ptolemy I are cornered against the northern cliff and ring edge just 12 metres from our two Armored Elephants. We send our elephants to finish off GPT's pocket while our surgeon heals them, and alert Grok that Claude's Hannibal group on the eastern rim is now the sole leader going into the final 25-second turn.
